title: MSFS Marketplace Update: Captain Sim drops THREE New 777s + fresh liveries! (Feb 7, 2026)
description:
🔍 Description
This week’s Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update (February 7, 2026) brings an exciting lineup of must‑have aircraft for PC simmers. From three brand‑new Boeing 777 variants to a sporty new 1500R, there’s a lot to explore in the hangar!

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Emerald Scenery Design: 1500R Sport (Lightweight and fun sport aircraft)
🛫 Captain Sim: Boeing 777‑200/200ER PW (Popular wide‑body twin‑engine release)
🛫 Captain Sim: Boeing 777‑300 PW (Stretched long‑range variant)
🛫 Captain Sim: Boeing 777‑300ER Freighter (Heavy cargo operations made affordable)

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🎨 Captain Sim: 777‑200/200ER PW Livery Pack 14
🎨 Captain Sim: 777‑200/200ER PW Livery Pack 20
🎨 Captain Sim: 777‑200ER PW Livery Pack 7
🎨 Captain Sim: 777‑300 PW Livery Pack 17
🎨 Captain Sim: 777‑300 PW Livery Pack 3
🎨 Captain Sim: 777‑300ERSF Livery Pack 1
🎨 2PILOT: C408 SkyCourier Ultimate Liveries (On sale this week)

If you enjoy these roundups, don’t forget to like the video, subscribe for weekly updates, and let me know in the comments which aircraft or livery you’re picking up!

✈️ See you in the skies!
